metadata.title: COSU Research Intake Terminal SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Research Intake Terminals as purpose-bound endpoint execution environments for research data collection and participant intake.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint dedicated to controlled research intake workflows such as participant check-in, consent capture, survey collection, or sample registration.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Research Intake Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint dedicated to research intake and data capture workflows.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved research intake, consent, survey, and data collection applications.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Participants interact via ephemeral, session-bound contexts with no persistent local identities.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Research Intake Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Research Intake Terminals are centrally enrolled, configured, and monitored.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for integrity, management, and trusted data transmission, not user or data entitlement.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration disables shell access, general productivity software, removable media, and unauthorized interfaces.

props.name: consent-and-integrity-controls
props.remarks: Controls ensure consent capture integrity, application fidelity, and prevention of input manipulation or tampering.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved research platforms, intake APIs, secure storage endpoints, and management services.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local storage of research or participant data is prohibited beyond transient, encrypted in-memory buffers.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Research Intake Terminals may participate only in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2 unless explicitly approved by research governance.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Participation in research intake does not imply eligibility for broader research data access or higher endpoint trust levels.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Terminal health, application state, and tamper-relevant events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Research Intake Terminals support deterministic session reset, periodic reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Research Intake Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on consent integrity, data minimization, and controlled research data flow.

roles.title: Research Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for design and operation of approved research intake workflows.

roles.title: Research Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves platforms, consent models, data classification scope, and exception handling.

roles.title: Endpoint Security Operations
roles.remarks: Ensures security posture, monitoring, and lifecycle governance for Research Intake Terminals.

control-implementation.remarks: Research Intake Terminal implementations are OS- and platform-specific and are maintained as tightly controlled, versioned configuration artifacts aligned with this SSPP.
